free_tier.stated: No free plan. A 7-day Pro trial gives $5 of usage and starts when a card is added at the first sandbox; signing up takes no card. Redeeming the trial needs a card on file.
free_tier.notes: a seven-day card-gated trial with USD 5 of usage credit

per_object_cap.stated: A Pro machine goes to 8 vCPU and 32 GB memory with 500 GB of fast storage; Growth goes to 16 vCPU, 64 GB and 2 TB; Scale goes to 32 vCPU, 96 GB and 5 TB.

retention.stated: A paused machine pays only for storage at USD 0.18 per GiB-month; a deleted machine costs nothing. After cancel or unpaid charge, machines pause and their disks, snapshots and volumes are deleted 30 days later.

egress.terms: No outbound traffic is free: every GB sent costs USD 0.03, charged from the plan's included usage; inbound traffic is free. Outbound traffic has no plan limit: each machine gets a fair share of its server's link by size.

notes: The dossier's existing record is `trial-only` with no m24h. The arithmetic at 24/7 for 1 GiB sitting idle: 0.05 vCPU x 0.025 + 1 GiB x 0.0075 = USD 0.00875/hour x 730 = USD 6.39. Busy at 1 vCPU: 0.025 + 0.0075 = USD 0.0325/hour x 730 = USD 23.73. Either way over USD 5, and the free tier is 100 hours, not a month. Egress: USD 0.02/GB x 1000 = USD 20 per TB beyond the 100 GiB allowance. Note the vendor's own framing (42% to 88% cheaper) is measured against agents that wait on a model, not against an always-on box, which is why the 730-hour figure is the one that decides.
